question: Could you provide the percentage of participants for standard acne, atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, and vitiligo as defined by the International Classification of Diseases 10-CM (ICD-10-CM), including their subcategories? Please include all related concepts mapped to the standard ICD-10-CM codes (L70 for acne, L20 for atopic dermatitis, L40 for psoriasis, and L80 for vitiligo) by utilizing concept relationships, including descendant concepts. The percentage should be calculated based on the total number of participants, considering only the standard concepts and their related descendants.

WITH RECURSIVE icd10_desc AS (
  SELECT 1569798 as ancestor_id, concept_id_2 as descendant_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 1569798 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM icd10_desc d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
    ON d.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
icd10_all AS (
  SELECT 1569798 as ancestor_id, 1569798 as descendant_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM icd10_desc
),
atopic_desc AS (
  SELECT 1569765 as ancestor_id, concept_id_2 as descendant_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 1569765 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM atopic_desc d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
    ON d.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
atopic_all AS (
  SELECT 1569765 as ancestor_id, 1569765 as descendant_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM atopic_desc
),
psoriasis_desc AS (
  SELECT 1569777 as ancestor_id, concept_id_2 as descendant_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 1569777 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM psoriasis_desc d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
    ON d.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
psoriasis_all AS (
  SELECT 1569777 as ancestor_id, 1569777 as descendant_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM psoriasis_desc
),
vitiligo_desc AS (
  SELECT 35208655 as ancestor_id, concept_id_2 as descendant_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 35208655 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM vitiligo_desc d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
    ON d.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
vitiligo_all AS (
  SELECT 35208655 as ancestor_id, 35208655 as descendant_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM vitiligo_desc
),
icd10_concepts AS (
  SELECT 'L70' as code, 'Acne' as name, descendant_id as concept_id FROM icd10_all WHERE ancestor_id = 1569798
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L20', 'Atopic dermatitis', descendant_id FROM atopic_all WHERE ancestor_id = 1569765
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L40', 'Psoriasis', descendant_id FROM psoriasis_all WHERE ancestor_id = 1569777
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L80', 'Vitiligo', descendant_id FROM vitiligo_all WHERE ancestor_id = 35208655
),
snomed_concepts AS (
  SELECT 'L70' as code, 'Acne' as name, descendant_concept_id as concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 141095
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L20', 'Atopic dermatitis', descendant_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 133834
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L40', 'Psoriasis', descendant_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 140168
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L80', 'Vitiligo', descendant_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 138502
),
all_concepts AS (
  SELECT * FROM icd10_concepts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM snomed_concepts
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as total FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
),
counts AS (
  SELECT ac.code, ac.name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) as cnt
  FROM all_concepts ac
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co
    ON ac.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  GROUP BY ac.code, ac.name
)
SELECT c.code, c.name, c.cnt, t.total, SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cnt, t.total) * 100 as percentage
FROM counts c
JOIN total t ON TRUE
ORDER BY c.code
